body.content: Counterfactual probe: if a city had identical thermal mass and sky view factor to the surrounding countryside, would there be a nocturnal UHI? The remaining candidate mechanisms would be: anthropogenic heat, reduced evapotranspiration, and reduced wind speed. This suggests a natural hierarchy: the dominant mechanism can be isolated by finding pairs of cities that differ in only one factor.
body.possible_next_move: Identify city pairs that differ primarily in one variable (e.g., Phoenix vs. Houston for evapotranspiration, Manhattan vs. Los Angeles for sky view) and examine observed UHI magnitudes.
body.why_keep_this: This decomposition could guide a cross-city empirical study to adjudicate between the rival single-mechanism claims.
